text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UAE President Sheikh Zayed calls King Hussein to discuss current Arab affairs. King Hussein reassured over Sheihh Zayed's health.
- Ministry of Public Works and Engineers Union sign memorandum of understanding. Engineers cancel today's planned protest after talks which lasted through Thursday night and most of Friday.
- Chaos and brawling after Faisali beat Wihdat 1-0.
- Ministry of Trade and Industry sends new companies law to the Prime Minister's office.
- Palestinian leader Arafat calls Prime Minister Kabariti. Arafat's adviser Abu Rdeinah says Arafat is keen to keep King Hussein in the picture on peace talks with Israel.
- Ministry of Supply sources say bread prices may come down early next year after Jordan's latest wheat purchases.
- Trade and Industry Minister Abu Ragheb says hopes parliament can pass speedy versions of Companies, Customs and Financial Markets laws.
